experiences.name: Whale watching cruise

experiences.caveat: Allen Marine runs the boat for both options. The cruise price includes the coach to Auke Bay; confirm whether the independent price does before comparing.

experiences.blurb: A six-minute ride from the cruise docks to about 1,800 feet with sweeping views and optional alpine walks. Low effort and right at the dock, IF it is running.
experiences.label: ideal_parents
experiences.mobility: Base station sits on the cruise docks (490 S. Franklin St). Wheelchair/ADA details are not on the operator's pages; call (907) 463-3412 before planning around it.
experiences.caveat: Do not plan around this attraction yet. See operating risk.

risk.text: The tram was closed all of the 2026 cruise season after an April crash. Goldbelt says it is confident it will be ready for 2027 but still needs a state certification and a replacement part (KTOO, Sep 24, 2026). Treat as unavailable until the operator confirms a 2027 opening.

coverage.summary: Excursion prices are published figures read on provider pages with no 2027 sailing selected. None are date-specific quotes, so none are labeled verified.

linesWithCruiseExcursionPrices.princess: Juneau, Skagway, Ketchikan, Sitka, Icy Strait Point: first page of each port listing only (12 excursions per port out of 20 to 63).
linesWithCruiseExcursionPrices.carnival: Four Alaska excursions (Juneau whale, Mendenhall, Icy Strait ZipRider, Ketchikan rainforest).
linesWithCruiseExcursionPrices.ncl: Four pages: White Pass railway, Mendenhall & whales, Juneau hatchery, Lumberjack Show (no price). A Totem Bight page showed euros only.

linesNotCaptured.hal: Holland America's excursion pages did not load for the automated reader.
linesNotCaptured.rci: Royal Caribbean's port page returned an error.
linesNotCaptured.celebrity: Celebrity's port page returned an error.

gaps: Icy Strait Point whale-watching prices (Princess listing page 2 not read).
Victoria excursion prices, including Butchart Gardens.
Dock-to-attraction walking distances were not measured; mobility notes rely on documented cruise-line descriptions and planner judgment.
Cancellation terms for most operators (only NCL 48 h, Frontier 24 h and the Goldbelt ticket rule were read).
Return-to-ship protection wording for independent tours was not read per operator.
Excursion-specific photos: cards use the port photo (Wikimedia Commons, already credited). Phase 4 can add tour photos.
subjectiveFields: exertion (0-5) combines the cruise line's published Easy/Moderate/Strenuous level with planner judgment
label (ideal for parents, suitable with precautions, best for brothers, great for everyone)
notes: Prices marked 'from' are minimums on listing pages; adult-specific fares were not always stated.
Reseller prices (Alaska Shore Excursions) are third-party prices for tours run by local operators; the page did not name the operator.
Low exertion is not the same as confirmed accessibility. Wheelchair flags are copied only where a page said so.
